description:
HushThreads v0.0.10 has 10 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (com.instagram.barcelona). It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.0. If you patch Instagram with HushGram using the same signing key, you can tap your Instagram account on Threads' login screen to sign in. Support reports now identify the exact bundle and leave file paths out, and the release check keeps Threads' cookies untouched. The patches are Hide ads, Hide suggested users, Block background-return feed refresh, Disable video autoplay, Sanitize sharing links, Open links in browser, Disable analytics, Remove the advertising ID, Restore screens on re-signed builds and HushThreads settings.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 513 runtime tests passed locally. All 183 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 10 patches applied to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85 without forcing, and the release receipt records both runs.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 449.0.0.54.82, version code 511908382. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
